title: Flash2OpenPMD: Conversion from FLASH to openPMD
description: Converts FLASH simulation output (HDF5 plot files) to the openPMD format, for use as initial density profiles in particle-in-cell codes such as PIConGPU. Supports Cartesian geometry and cylindrical (r, z) geometry, which is rotated about its axis of symmetry into a 3D Cartesian volume, with optional GPU acceleration. Provides both a command-line interface and a graphical user interface.
